name: MRSO.,Inc
summary: MRSO, Inc. provides a platform for managing appointments for medical check-ups and health screenings. Its offerings are the Health Care Platform, through which people book examinations online via the MRSO.jp portal, DX services implementing a web-based reservation system for health check-ups, and solutions for large-scale vaccination programs. Tsunegoro Nishino founded it in 2015, and it has its base in Tokyo, Japan.
